profile.name: Abolfazl Keshavarz
profile.headline: I build dependable systems, from embedded devices to production servers.
profile.lede: Computer Science graduate of the University of Guilan. I work across the whole stack — firmware, networks, backend services, interfaces and deployment — and I'm drawn to the questions underneath it: machine learning, its security, and how connected systems are designed.
aboutParagraphs: My bachelor's years at the University of Guilan gave me a broad foundation — algorithms, operating systems, computer networks, databases and microprocessors — and a habit of understanding a system all the way down before building on it. I took part in an international systematic literature review on digital twin ecosystems, and finished with a senior project on deepfake detection.

Alongside the degree I built things people actually use: a GPS tracking platform, a real-time messaging service, a restaurant ordering platform, and attendance and management systems for local businesses. I like owning a system end to end, including the unglamorous parts — provisioning, backups, TLS and migrations.
I also taught. As a teaching assistant and later a programming instructor I worked with roughly 150 students, which taught me more about explaining ideas clearly than any course did.
My interests lie in AI, AI security and connected systems, and I keep looking for problems where those meet real engineering.

research.title: Researcher, Digital Twin Ecosystem Design
bullets: Carried out data extraction, classification and analysis of digital twin frameworks as part of a systematic literature review.
Worked with an international research team on digital twin ecosystems: their architectures and the relationships between ecosystem stakeholders.
Contributed to the preparation of a comprehensive systematic literature review on the subject.

projects.title: Cofferant
projects.summary: A multi-tenant platform that takes a restaurant from a QR-code menu to online ordering, order tracking and a live kitchen view.
highlights: Django-based platform with QR-code menus, online ordering, order tracking and live kitchen operations.
Restaurant management, payment integration, coupon handling and subscription licensing.
Multi-tenant deployment with tenant data isolation, Docker, Nginx, automated backups, and VPS provisioning and migration scripts.

projects.title: Chatters
projects.summary: A messaging service with direct and group conversations, built to run on a server I administer myself.
highlights: Direct and group messaging, persistent storage, read-status tracking, replies and media sharing.
Go and Gin backend with WebSockets and JWT authentication; React front end; PostgreSQL.
Deployed on a Linux VPS with systemd and Nginx, with HTTPS and PostgreSQL configured by hand.

projects.title: RadGard
projects.summary: A fleet-tracking system for cars and motorcycles, from the tracker unit through cellular telemetry to a live map, deployed on its own domain.
highlights: Tracker hardware: ESP32 with a NEO-6M GPS receiver and SIM800C GSM/GPRS modem reporting over MQTT.
Backend in Go with MQTT ingestion, PostgreSQL history, a Redis latest-state cache, JWT auth, and REST plus WebSocket push.
React and TypeScript dashboard on MapLibre GL over self-hosted OpenStreetMap tiles.

projects.title: Deepfake Detection
projects.summary: A machine-learning study of how to detect manipulated media on the multi-face DF-Platter dataset.
highlights: Data preparation, model development and evaluation on DF-Platter.
Classifies images as real or AI-generated using Python, OpenCV and TensorFlow.

projects.title: IoT Body Vitals Monitoring
projects.summary: ESP32 station measuring heart rate, SpO₂ and body temperature (MAX30100, MAX30205), with an HTTP API and a Python/Tkinter application that collects and stores the readings.

projects.title: Live Health Monitor
projects.summary: A standalone ESP8266 pulse oximeter with a MAX30100 sensor and OLED display, serving live heart-rate and SpO₂ readings from its own web server.

projects.title: Guarantee Management System
projects.summary: Warranty lifecycle for a home-appliance business: roles, technicians, repairs, spare-part requests and global search, with Go, Gin, GORM, PostgreSQL and React.

projects.title: Personnel Attendance System
projects.summary: Staff clock in by face at a tablet kiosk; recognition runs in the browser so it keeps working when the network drops. FastAPI backend, React front end, Persian RTL with Jalali dates.

projects.title: Gym Management System
projects.summary: Persian right-to-left site and admin panel for a gym: memberships with printable cards, plans, coaches, class schedules and Excel/PDF reports. Node.js, Express and SQLite.

projects.title: Plant Infection Classification
projects.summary: A YOLO11x binary classifier separating fungal-infected plants from healthy ones on a custom dataset, reaching 100% top-1 accuracy on the held-out test set.
